Run FitDevo developmental potential scoring

Source: R/RunFitDevo.R
RunFitDevo.Rd

Run FitDevo developmental potential scoring

Usage

RunFitDevo(
  object,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  features = NULL,
  nfeatures = 2000,
  reference.by = NULL,
  score.name = "FitDevo_Score",
  relative.name = "FitDevo_Relative",
  tool_name = "FitDevo",
  verbose = TRUE,
  backend = c("cpp", "r")
)

Arguments

object

A Seurat object or expression matrix with genes in rows and cells in columns.

assay

Assay used for Seurat input.

layer

Layer used for Seurat input.

features

Features used for scoring. If NULL, the most variable genes are selected.

nfeatures

Number of variable genes selected when features = NULL.

reference.by

Optional metadata column containing ordered development labels. Numeric values are used directly; factors use their level order.

score.name

Metadata column for the developmental potential score.

relative.name

Metadata column for the relative rank.

tool_name

Name used in srt@tools.

verbose

Whether to print progress messages.

backend

Computation backend. "cpp" avoids materializing the full feature-by-cell rank matrix for supervised scoring; "r" retains the reference implementation.

Value

A modified Seurat object or a result bundle for matrix input.

References

Zhang F, Yang C, Wang Y, Jiao H, Wang Z, Shen J, Li L. FitDevo: accurate inference of single-cell developmental potential using sample-specific gene weight. Briefings in Bioinformatics, 2022. doi:10.1093/bib/bbac293.

Examples

Restored example output generated on 2026-10-13 from SCOP 53ed7e08f. These historical examples have not been revalidated against the current release. Current usage and arguments are documented above.

data(pancreas_sub)
pancreas_sub <- RunStandardWorkflow(pancreas_sub)
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Start standard processing workflow...
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Checking a list of <Seurat>...
#> ! [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Data 1/1 of the `srt_list` is "unknown"
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Perform `NormalizeData()` with `normalization.method = 'LogNormalize'` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Perform `FindVariableFeatures()` on 1/1 of `srt_list`...
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Use the separate HVF from `srt_list`
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Number of available HVF: 2000
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Finished check
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Perform `ScaleData()`
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:01] Perform pca linear dimension reduction
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:02] Use stored estimated dimensions 1:23 for Standardpca
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:02] Perform `Seurat::FindClusters()` with `cluster_algorithm = 'louvain'` and `cluster_resolution = 0.6`
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:02] Reorder clusters...
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:02] Skip `log1p()` because `layer = data` is not "counts"

pancreas_sub <- RunFitDevo(
  pancreas_sub,
  nfeatures = 300
)
#> ℹ [2026-10-13 16:56:12] Run FitDevo scoring with 300 features and 1000 cells
FeatureDimPlot(pancreas_sub, features = "FitDevo_Score")

FitDevoPlot(
  pancreas_sub,
  group.by = "SubCellType",
  xlab = "UMAP_1",
  ylab = "UMAP_2"
)
